The Fuudi attacked and damaged one of the windmills.[XENO:n ]
Resolve the various problems plaguing the Ether Plant.
Teach the Fuudi leader a lesson.

At the Ether Plant in Eryth Sea,[XENO:n ]
finish repairing the Windmill 4 Control Panel.
Return to Jack.

You've resolved the Ether Plant's problems.[XENO:n ]
Now Jack should be able to head off to fix the lighthouse.

Find the Fuudi Refuge[XENO:n ]
and teach the Fuudi leader a lesson.

At the Fuudi Refuge in Eryth Sea,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Funeral Gozra[/System:Color].
You defeated the Fuudi leader and secured the windmill.
Repair the windmill the Fuudi damaged.

Obtain 3 pieces of [System:Color name=item ]Luxury Fuudi Wood[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Fuudi in Eryth Sea.
Return to Jack.

At the Ether Plant in Eryth Sea,[XENO:n ]
repair the Windmill 4 Control Panel.
Return to Jack.

You gathered materials and repaired the windmill.[XENO:n ]
All the windmills are now operating.
Fight off the remaining Fuudi who came seeking revenge.

Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Confusion Ekidnos[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Eryth Sea.
Return to Jack.

You fought off the remaining Fuudi.[XENO:n ]
Now all the Ether Plant's problems are finally resolved.

The lighthouse has suffered further damage and all its[XENO:n ]
lights are out. There's a risk of attack after dark,[XENO:n ]
so protect the lighthouse from monsters.

At Syrath Lighthouse in Eryth Sea,[XENO:n ]
defeat 3 [System:Color name=item ]Decay Ekidnos[/System:Color] (night only).
Return to Sherren.

You protected the lighthouse and completed repairs.[XENO:n ]
Its light now shines in every direction.

Talia seems to have headed to Satorl Marsh alone,[XENO:n ]
despite Milia's attempts to stop her. At this rate,[XENO:n ]
Talia's life is in danger. Go and help her.

Near Judgment Chamber in Satorl Marsh,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Dogmatic Gogol[/System:Color].

Near Judgment Chamber in Satorl Marsh,[XENO:n ]
talk to Talia.

At the Ether Plant in Eryth Sea,[XENO:n ]
talk to Talia.

Talia wanted to finish her research into worship of[XENO:n ]
the War God for her late colleagues.

The true statue of the War God seems to be on Valak Mountain.[XENO:n ]
Finish the research into War God worship to honour[XENO:n ]
the wishes of the late Russ and Natori.

At La Luz Church on Valak Mountain,[XENO:n ]
examine the statue of the War God.
Report to Talia.

War God worship originated on Valak Mountain.[XENO:n ]
At last, the three researchers' work is complete.

While fleeing the capital, Tet, who was with Milia,[XENO:n ]
disappeared without her noticing.[XENO:n ]
Find Tet and make sure he's safe.
Talk to Tet.
Return to Milia.

You found Tet hiding in the capital and rescued him,[XENO:n ]
putting Milia's mind at ease.

Some Telethia helped Vivian flee the capital.[XENO:n ]
She sensed it was her best friend and her friend's child.[XENO:n ]
Go and see whether it really was them.

Defeat 10 [System:Color name=item ]Arel Telethia[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Imperial Capital Achamoth.

Near the Fountain of Eternity in Imperial Capital Achamoth,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Telethia Arietta[/System:Color].

Near Melfica Road in Imperial Capital Achamoth,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Telethia Louise[/System:Color].
Return to Vivian.

It really was them who helped Vivian.[XENO:n ]
Vivian offered a tearful prayer for them both.

Some Telethia helped Vivian flee the capital,[XENO:n ]
and they were her best friend and her friend's child.[XENO:n ]
It's sad, but release them from that form.

Defeat 10 [System:Color name=item ]Arel Telethia[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Imperial Capital Achamoth.

Near the Fountain of Eternity in Imperial Capital Achamoth,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Telethia Arietta[/System:Color].

Near Melfica Road in Imperial Capital Achamoth,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Telethia Louise[/System:Color].
Return to Vivian.

Her best friend and the child were freed of Telethia form.[XENO:n ]
Vivian offered a tearful prayer for them both.

There seems to be a facility in the High Entia Tomb[XENO:n ]
where research into Telethia was conducted.[XENO:n ]
Go to the tomb and look for the laboratory!

At the Telethia Laboratory in the High Entia Tomb,[XENO:n ]
obtain [System:Color name=item ]Telethia Research[/System:Color].
Return to Tet.

You found the Telethia Research records in the lab.[XENO:n ]
Perhaps one day everyone can regain their original forms.

Monsters in Eryth Sea are growing more active.[XENO:n ]
Defeat them before they endanger anyone.

Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Palti Spicals[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Eryth Sea.

You fulfilled the High Entia lighthouse keeper's request.[XENO:n ]
Eryth Sea is a little more peaceful.

Monsters in Eryth Sea are growing more active.[XENO:n ]
Defeat them before they endanger anyone.

Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Maleza Spicals[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Eryth Sea.

You fulfilled the High Entia lighthouse keeper's request.[XENO:n ]
Eryth Sea is a little more peaceful.

Monsters in Eryth Sea are growing more active.[XENO:n ]
Defeat them before they endanger anyone.

Near Hovering Reef 5 in Eryth Sea,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Thunderclap Jirone[/System:Color].

You fulfilled the High Entia lighthouse keeper's request.[XENO:n ]
Eryth Sea is a little more peaceful.

Someone wants to study Eryth Sea but can't find specimens.[XENO:n ]
Gather materials and collectible items.

Obtain 3 [System:Color name=item ]Hirun Coin Purses[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Eryth Hiruns in Eryth Sea.

Obtain 5 [System:Color name=item ]Doomsday Poppies[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Eryth Sea.

You fulfilled an Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
Research into Eryth Sea should progress.

Someone wants to study Eryth Sea but can't find specimens.[XENO:n ]
Gather materials and collectible items.

Obtain 3 [System:Color name=item ]Long Andos Antennae[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Andos in the High Entia Tomb.

Obtain 3 [System:Color name=item ]Old Dragon Fins[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Racti Lexos in Eryth Sea.

Obtain 3 [System:Color name=item ]Aspara Bombs[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Eryth Sea.

You fulfilled an Achamoth resident's request.[XENO:n ]
Research into Eryth Sea should progress.

A worker repairing a transporter near Syrath Lighthouse[XENO:n ]
in Eryth Sea called for help, after which communications[XENO:n ]
ceased. Go and rescue the worker.

Head to Hovering Reef 4, where Syrath Lighthouse stands,[XENO:n ]
and ask the man who made the report where the worker went.

Head to the Ether Crystal Deposit[XENO:n ]
accessible from behind Syrath Lighthouse.
Save the worker being attacked by Spicals.
Talk to the worker.

You rescued the worker.[XENO:n ]
Now the broken transporter should be repaired.

To reach Prison Island, use the sealed transporter[XENO:n ]
on Central Seal Island. Open the sister gates Khatorl[XENO:n ]
and Soltnar to break the seal on the transporter.
Open the sister gates Khatorl and Soltnar.

Operate the Prison Island Seal Release[XENO:n ]
that appeared on Central Seal Island.

The seal on the transporter is broken,[XENO:n ]
and Prison Island is now accessible.

To open Khatorl and Soltnar, the two giant sister gates[XENO:n ]
guarding the transporter to Prison Island,[XENO:n ]
break the seals on Khatorl and Soltnar Seal Islands.
Release the seal on Khatorl Seal Island.
Release the seal on Soltnar Seal Island.
The sister gates Khatorl and Soltnar have opened.
